sources.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
sources.supports: Semi-autoregressive drafting; conditional acceptance and calibrated prefix survival; engine-profiled verification budgets; distinction between frozen-target method, offline evaluation and preview production setup; early stopping and asynchronous historical-capacity adaptation.
sources.limits: No vendor code, checkpoints, calibration data or engine profile is executed here. The local probabilities, cost curves and selection-bias counterexample are independently specified teaching data, not the paper's numerical experiments.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
sources.supports: Three drafter blocks, window 128, five base-logit positions, Markov head; DSpark-only training with frozen backbone after pretraining; continued co-training during posttraining without DSpark-objective gradients flowing to the backbone; serving and RL/OPD rollouts.
sources.limits: Do not call the posttraining backbone globally frozen. Do not transfer offline DSpark defaults, preview deployment details or reported speedups to V4.1 without an explicit disclosure.

sources.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
sources.supports: Sequential draft verification, residual correction, bonus draw and the expected emitted-length convention.
sources.limits: The site's existing speculativeMass and speculativeToken implement the same single-position probability ledger. Reusing them is not a model or GPU benchmark.

localScope: Exact finite teaching processes and exhaustive discrete choices on inputs frozen before results; no actual DSpark training, STS fit, production scheduler or hardware timing.
